description: Exponentiation squares a live side length
code:
side = 3
area = side ** 2
assert(area, 9)
side = 5
area

description: Exponentiation groups to the right and binds tighter than multiplication
code:
base = 2
exponent = 3
tower = base ** exponent ** 2
scaled = 3 * base ** exponent
assert(tower, 512)
assert(scaled, 24)
exponent = 2
tower

description: A prefix minus applies to the whole power as in Python
code:
x = 3
negated = -x ** 2
grouped = (-x) ** 2
assert(negated, -9)
assert(grouped, 9)
x = 2
[negated, grouped]

description: Compound exponentiation keeps a standing relationship with its exponent
code:
value = 16
rate = 0.5
value **= rate
assert(value, 4)
rate = 2
value

description: A class-level rule computes each cube's volume with exponentiation
code:
class Cube(side):
    this.side = side
$Cube.volume = $Cube.side ** 3
small = Cube(2)
assert(small.volume, 8)
small.side = 4
small.volume

description: Exponentiation gives the coercions and special values of Math.pow
code:
base = "3"
power = 2
result = base ** power
assert(result, Math.pow("3", 2))
base = true
assert(result, 1)
base = -8
power = 1 / 3
Number.isNaN(result)

description: Compound interest follows a live rate and term
code:
rate = 0.5
years = 2
balance = 100 * (1 + rate) ** years
assert(balance, 225)
years = 3
balance
